offering_description.value: Holding company whose Great American Insurance Group subsidiaries underwrite specialty property and casualty insurance for businesses. Products cover niche markets such as specialty casualty, property and transportation, and specialty financial lines. Sold mainly through independent agents and brokers.

primary_products.value: specialty property and casualty insurance; crop insurance; commercial auto and transportation insurance; excess and surplus lines; fidelity and surety bonds

customer_segment.value: B2B: businesses, farms, nonprofits and trucking firms buying commercial specialty insurance

end_markets.value: agriculture; transportation; commercial property; financial services; nonprofit and social services

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: insurance premiums written and earned, plus investment income on the portfolio

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: underwrites and carries risk, taking premiums from commercial policyholders sold via agents and brokers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States, with some business in Canada, the UK, Europe and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: specialty property and transportation, specialty casualty, and specialty financial insurance lines

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent retail and wholesale agents and brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance underwriting regulated by state insurance departments, NAIC rules, solvency and rate approval requirements

divestiture_lines: P2.9: Sale of Commercial Lines Division
P2.15: Sale of long-term care business
P2.21: Sale of Annuity Business to MassMutual
